description: This file contains internal testing classes and functions for pruning and model architecture testing in PyTorch, including mock layers, model definitions with various layer configurations, and utility functions.

classes.name: ImplementedSparsifier
classes.description: A custom sparsifier class for testing pruning mask updates.

classes.name: MockSparseLinear
classes.description: A mock linear layer class for conversion testing, with a from_dense method.

classes.name: SimpleLinear
classes.description: A simple model with sequential linear layers without biases for testing linear fusion.

classes.name: LinearBias
classes.description: A linear model with alternating bias and bias-free layers for testing bias fusion.

classes.name: LinearActivation
classes.description: A linear model with activation functions between layers for testing activation fusion.

classes.name: LinearActivationFunctional
classes.description: A linear model with functional activations between layers for testing fusion.

classes.name: SimpleConv2d
classes.description: A simple convolutional model with sequential conv layers without biases for testing conv fusion.

classes.name: Conv2dBias
classes.description: A convolutional model with bias and bias-free layers for testing bias fusion.

classes.name: Conv2dActivation
classes.description: A conv model with activation modules in between for testing conv-activation fusion.

classes.name: Conv2dPadBias
classes.description: A conv model with padding and bias for testing bias propagation with padding.

classes.name: Conv2dPool
classes.description: A conv model with pooling layers for testing conv-pool fusion.

classes.name: Conv2dPoolFlattenFunctional
classes.description: A conv model with pooling, flatten, and linear layers, with functional flatten, for testing pooling and flatten fusion.

classes.name: Conv2dPoolFlatten
classes.description: A conv model with pooling, flatten, and linear layers for testing pooling and flatten fusion.

classes.name: LSTMLinearModel
classes.description: A container model with an LSTM and a linear layer for sequence modeling tests.

classes.name: LSTMLayerNormLinearModel
classes.description: A container model with an LSTM, LayerNorm, and linear layer for sequence and normalization tests.

methods.name: update_mask
methods.description: Updates the pruning mask for a module.

methods.name: from_dense
methods.description: Converts a dense nn.Linear layer to a MockSparseLinear.

methods.name: rows_are_subset
methods.description: Checks if all rows in one tensor are present in another tensor.
